metadata.description: Spec-driven code generation plugins for Augentic.

plugins.name: capture
plugins.description: Skills to capture runtime fixtures from legacy TypeScript services for Specify migration workflows.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Skills for the Specify workflow: `/spec:init` scaffolds a project, `/spec:plan` authors the change-level plan, the per-slice breakouts (`/spec:refine`, `/spec:build`, `/spec:merge`, `/spec:drop`) drive one slice at a time, and `/spec:finalize` closes the change; the drained execute loop is the guest-routed `specify plan execute` verb.
